answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> The Holy Quran Question ID: 31449 Country: India Title: Can women recite durood , kalma's n other daily duas in peroids (menses). Question: Can women recite durood , kalma's n other daily duas in peroids (menses). for eg toilets going n coming, khana kane ki dua , bhahar gani ki dua . etc. n can we do zikr in peroids and what dua is prohibited in peroids.jazak allah Answer ID: 31449 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 667/474/L=1432) A woman can recite during her menstruation all types of zikr and dua except the holy Quran. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
